hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/skills/i-have-adhd"; [ -f "$d/hooks/always-on.mjs" ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || for n in "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin; do [ -x "$n/node" ] && { PATH="$n:$PATH"; break; }; done; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$d" exec node "$d/hooks/always-on.mjs"
